title: Triads — Introduction

blocks.text:
**Track:** theory | **Tier:** intro | **Difficulty:** 2/10
**Prerequisites:** Major Scales — Introduction
**Tags:** triads, chords
A **triad** stacks two thirds above a root — the basic harmonic unit of Western and much folk music.

- **Major**: M3 + m3 (C-E-G)
- **Minor**: m3 + M3 (A-C-E)
- **Diminished**: m3 + m3 (B-D-F)
- **Augmented**: M3 + M3 (C-E-G♯)
I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii° — capital = major, lowercase = minor, ° = diminished.

- A) C-E-G
- B) C-E♭-G
- C) C-F-A
- D) C-D-G

**Answer:** A
